lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: You know did he, when he shot her you said how many times.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Do you know did he hit her every time?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: OK. Did he hit anything else in the garage at all?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Where was he standing when he shot her?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Why don’t you put an X there and put his initials there. And where were you standing?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: OK put your initials there. Was there blood anywhere else?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: What about behind the vehicle or anything like that?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: No? All right, why don’t you sign it. (door opens) (pause) (door closes) And put the time in. 1:51 looks like. OK. Um, looks good to me.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: All right, but, did you want him ta maybe draw the fire pit, or sketch of the fire pit in the back

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Can you do that? (Brendan nods “yes”) We did it the other day so let’s, let’s try that. Give that back ta ya.
